messages: alex: alert: spike in inference latency for hosted/v1-gen - multiple backends hitting high p99. Seeing ~600-900ms from baseline 120ms. Alert group: infra-high-latency. incident-bot: INCIDENT #7891 created · Severity: P2 · Paging: oncall-engineer · Link: https://incidents.redwood/7891 alex: I’m on it — checking routing and recent deploys. No deploys in last 30m. Investigating model hotshard and queue depth. sam: I see increased queue length on gpu-pool-a, slow drains. Might be batching config change? jamie: incoming logs show a flurry of retry storms from a downstream service at ~09:12UTC, could be causing head-of-line blocking. maria: taking pager. @alex handoff in 2m — can you capture any mitigation steps you try? alex: will do. first mitigation: reduced batch_target_ms from 25 -> 10 on worker group to force smaller batches, restarting a small subset (canary) now. command: `rdwctl rollout --group gpu-pool-a --batch-config '{}`
